card.name: Just before a woman's first name
card.fires_on: The word or mark right before a woman's given name, such as "Ms.", "married", "his wife", "by the name of", or "and" in a couple. It fires when a female name is expected next.

modes.label: Title before name
modes.description: The period after "Ms" just before a woman's first name.
modes.example: UNDP Country Director, Ms<<.>> Anne-Isabelle Degryse-

modes.label: Marriage and family links
modes.description: Words like "married" or "and" that lead into a wife's or partner's name.
modes.example: On January 2, 1854, he<< married>> Frances Sarah Brown, from the nearby village

modes.label: Introducing a named woman
modes.description: Phrases like "by the name of" or a comma after "a friend" that lead into a woman's name.
modes.example: Among them was a friend<<,>> Dora Wolfov

card.writes: It boosts common female first names like Maria, Ann and Elizabeth, and lowers male names like William, James and John.
card.plain: It signals that a woman's first name is about to come next, not a man's.
